name: Today
description: Your day at a glance: a short brief of your schedule, reminders and weather, with an optional AI summary from Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek or any compatible endpoint, plus a meeting countdown with a Join button.
author: Michael Wiseman

secrets.label: Anthropic API key (optional)
secrets.description: Only used if you turn on AI brief and pick Anthropic. Sent only to api.anthropic.com.

secrets.label: OpenAI API key (optional)
secrets.description: Only used if you turn on AI brief and pick OpenAI. Sent only to api.openai.com.

secrets.label: Google Gemini API key (optional)
secrets.description: Only used if you turn on AI brief and pick Gemini. Sent only to generativelanguage.googleapis.com.

secrets.label: DeepSeek API key (optional)
secrets.description: Only used if you turn on AI brief and pick DeepSeek. Sent only to api.deepseek.com.

secrets.label: Custom endpoint API key (optional)
secrets.description: Only used if you pick Custom. Sent only to the base URL you enter. Not needed for local models.
